description: Allocation benchmark on 4 held-out maps x 2 episodes (abstract grid env, 3 robots, 32m world, 5 victims, 600-step cap). Policy: MAPPO ~148k steps (runs/mappo_v1). Values are mean +/- std across 4 episodes.
provenance: training/evaluate.py runs of 2026-09-12; training curve from runs/mappo_v1 console logs (reports/training_curve.csv)

rows.note: argmax mode collapses at this training budget; deployment node defaults to sampling
